streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

visualReviewMethod: All nine freshly extracted final PNG frames at 0, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49 and 55.9 seconds were opened with view_image and actually inspected after the encoder timing fix. SHA-256 values were recalculated from these fresh files. No GPU rendering, geometry changes or image edits were performed. Existing full-decode, frame-timing and probe results are preserved.
visualReviewScope: Sampled-frame reflection detail, framing, captions, attribution and approximate start/end composition; not continuous playback or a frame-by-frame temporal review.
visualFindings: Cloud Gate remains fully framed, centered and unobstructed in all nine inspected views, including the end-on compositions at 7 and 35 seconds.
Curved skyline and lit-window reflections remain coherent on the upper steel shell; warm plaza lighting and reflected paving joints define the lower shell, arch and concave underside.
The sampled sequence progresses around the sculpture and returns to nearly the opening composition at 55.9 seconds, with no sampled location jump or camera obstruction.

The Atelier / Millennium title and Cloud Gate caption are legible and clear of the sculpture. The architectural reconstruction / OpenStreetMap contributors attribution remains legible in every sample.
No gross frame corruption, large isolated firefly bloom, clipped sculpture or missing geometry is visible in the inspected frames.
Preserved final validation metadata confirms 1344 decoded frames over 56 seconds at exact 24/1 fps, successful full decode and uniform frame timing.
visualLimits: Residual Monte Carlo grain remains on the lower mirrored shell, reflected plaza and shaded vegetation at 24 samples per frame. The initial frame is visibly grainier than later samples; this export is not noise-free.
Bright reflected fixture highlights are saturated and plaza light pools remain pronounced; photometry is an authored approximation.
Nine isolated frames cannot establish absence of all flicker or ghosting, complete temporal smoothness or exact loop-seam continuity. No continuous movie playback was performed by this visual review.
Simplified solid tree crowns and repeated generic city facades remain visible background approximations.
